t: 2030 — First governed program hulls field trials: program logistics mon
title: 2030 — First governed program hulls field trials: program logistics mon
definition: 2030 milestone on the Biochar District Programs roadmap.
description:
First governed program hulls field trials: program logistics monitoring published openly, feedstock oversight in place.

What must be true first: the pyrolysis units results have to replicate outside the lab, program logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and feedstock operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed pyrolysis units demonstrations, program logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting feedstock uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Biochar District Programs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Biochar District Programs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Biochar District Programs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 15524 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where pyrolysis units monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or feedstock maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Biochar District Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Biochar District Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Biochar District Programs — districts scaling biochar for carbon.

Phase 1 — Prove (pyrolysis units): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (feedstock): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (soil benefits): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and agriculture-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
